description: Diffuse, graded pattern with no crisp rule. Strongest when the opponent's last stone sits high in column 1 (rows 3-5) or column 6 (rows 2-4), column 2 and column 0 are empty or nearly empty, column 4 is tall, and the opponent has stones low in columns 5-6. Opponent stones in columns 0/2 or my stones in column 3 weaken it. No single cell or threat is enough on its own.
effect: none measurable (steering to max or zero changes move probabilities by <=0.01 on 4 positions)
notes: Layer 1. Activation depends on the board (not the move order) and shifts with many cells at once. Additive score p1 F1 0.241 (AUROC 0.64, sim share 0.10); per-column-count linear 0.207; last-move-cell rule 0.186; adding their row-3 threats/parity 0.214. Opponent diagonal or vertical-three hypotheses failed in minimal pairs. May be a random direction. Synthesis best 3.49, below the dev max 3.578.
